WHOSE FACE YOU MUST NOT TOUCH — this is the hard rule of this job: every OTHER person in the frame. Any man, any groom, any second woman, any child, any person in a small reference panel or inset. If you are unsure whether a person is her, leave that person alone.

· high, rounded cheekbones with a warm pink blush sitting high on the cheek
· fair porcelain skin, early twenties
